answers.why: The Philistines fight against Israel's army at Gilboa.
The men of Israel flee from the Philistines and fall slain.
Israel's inhabitants beyond the valley and Jordan abandon their cities.
The men of Israel are soldiers who flee when Saul's army is defeated.
The messenger escapes from Israel's military camp under Saul.
The house of Israel is mourned because its people fell by the sword.
The lament addresses Israel over its mighty warriors slain on its heights.
Israel's women are called to weep over Saul, who clothed them richly.
Ishbosheth is made king over Ephraim alongside other tribal territories.
Abner makes Ishbosheth king over all Israel.
Ishbosheth reigns over Israel while the house of Judah follows David.
The men of Israel fight under Abner and are defeated by David's servants.
Joab's troops stop pursuing Israel, identified nearby as Abner and his men.
